features.note: Facade/public/corridor/auditorium sequence is readable across the required presets. neutral and complete-network keep the front band, lit 7 m spine and the two 4-block flanks legible even at night; corridor shows the numbered auditorium doors down the spine; lobby shows the public band. The plan grammar survives the lighting. Held back from higher by the facade preset, which frames the building as a thin horizontal band with ~45% empty black sky above and ~35% empty flat plaza below.

Expectation is 'low-level aisle/exit/screen light reveals silhouettes'. The light in sala-3/reference-match is NOT low-level: the auditorium ceiling and upper side walls are washed to near-white blue-white pools (visually the brightest ceiling in the entire capture set, brighter than the lobby ceiling), so the room reads as a lit tunnel rather than a dark house. Aisle strips and step nosings do read and do spill a little onto the aisle, and the screen bounce carves the far wall, but the exit signs inside the room are reduced to 2-3 px green dashes on the side walls and are not readable in the architecture state (they ARE readable in eng-sala-3, so the emissive exists and is simply too weak/too small for the architecture rig). Tiered seating slabs and rake are legible in outline; no penalty applied for their block-level detail, which earlier passes own.

Strongest part of the pass. lobby lights-on: ceiling reads as a genuinely lit surface (luminous coffer troughs with a visible hot centre and falloff to the wall), tile gloss shows real specular streaks and reflected fixture smears, red accents (soffit band, DRINKS board, menu strips) sit clearly above the wall value, and the counter/kiosk line stays focal without clipping the checkpoint. Marquee is focal in facade and grazing. Only deduction: the lobby FLOOR barely darkens in lights-off while the ceiling and panels go black, which is an ambient leak.

Lighting has not broken what earlier passes gated. eng-complete-network exposes all endpoint groups without occlusion: RS-485 green trunks are traceable end-to-end, TC300-01..14 labels are crisp, UC-A/UC-B/UC-C/UC-D and the BUS-A..D route labels are legible, LoRaWAN reads as blue dashed, the Ethernet chain ROUTER/FIREWALL -> INTERNET -> NIAGARA -> PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE is blue solid and fully labelled, and the external schematic board is readable. eng-sala-3 keeps TC300-07/TC300-08 labels and the green bus sharp. eng-neutral is on the dim side (fill is not raised as lighting_notes.engineering asks) but every media style stays unambiguous.

Both states remain legible in their intended state across neutral, grazing and reference-match. Architecture stays opaque and lit; engineering keeps the translucent shell, colored zone volumes and link media without blooming into unreadable bands. Deduction only for eng-neutral reading underexposed relative to the architecture neutral.

important_features.note: The 1.8 m figure at the facade and in the corridor reads correctly against the door bank and the 4.5 m public band; the lighting does not inflate or hide any device. TC300 status rings and UC/UG labels stay small and correctly scaled in the eng captures.

Three of the four tiers are excellent and one inverts. Exterior/forecourt is brightest; the lobby is warm, fixture-lit with real falloff and red accents above the wall value; the corridor is genuinely dim-but-legible (carpet pattern, door leaves, poster boxes, numbered signs and EXIT plates all readable, with visible elliptical wall-wash pools and falloff between fixtures). The fourth tier fails: the auditorium is not near-dark. Its ceiling and upper side walls carry blown blue-white glow pools that are the brightest interior surfaces in the whole set. The mechanical sidecar's zone_luminance table samples auditorium wall/floor/cross_aisle/lining/nosing/seat but NOT the ceiling, which is precisely the surface that breaks the ladder. Separately, the forecourt shows no spill: the plaza is pixel-for-pixel the same gray in lights-on and lights-off in facade and grazing, so the marquee/canopy contribute nothing to the ground.

In the engineering captures the RS-485 trunks stay on their trays, the drops land on their TC300s, and the UC->UG67 links stay dashed and cable-free. Nothing floats and the lighting has not made any containment run ambiguous.

defects: sala-3 and reference-match, lights-on: the auditorium ceiling and the upper third of both side walls are washed with large soft blue-white glow pools that clip toward white. These ceiling/wall pools are visually brighter than the lobby ceiling, so the luminance ladder INVERTS at the fourth tier - the darkest room in the building renders as the brightest ceiling in the capture set. The house reads as a lit tunnel, not a cinema.

sala-3, lights-on, architecture state: the in-room exit signs are reduced to 2-3 px green dashes on the side walls at roughly (700,865) and (1290,875) and are not readable. eng-sala-3 shows the same signs rendering as crisp green EXIT plates, so the geometry and emissive exist and are simply under-driven for the architecture rig. The spec's 'readable aisle/exit lights' is unmet in the state that is supposed to prove it.

sala-3: the wall-fixture glows read as soft round sprite halos floating on the wall rather than as light with a physical falloff profile - the bright ellipse does not attach to any visible luminaire body and its gradient is symmetric top-to-bottom.

facade, both light states: the composition is a thin band between voids. The building occupies only the middle ~20% of the frame; the top ~45% is empty black sky and the bottom ~35% is an empty, uniformly flat plaza. The marquee band is also clipped by the left and right frame edges.

facade and grazing: no forecourt spill. The plaza gray is identical in lights-on and lights-off - the marquee, the canopy downlights and the poster bank cast no pool, no gradient and no falloff onto the ground. The canopy soffit correctly darkens, which proves the channel switches; the ground simply never receives it.

grazing: the plaza and the white shell panels resolve as one flat gradient with no specular variation - smooth-plastic response. The low angle exposes no breakup, no grazing sheen on the concrete and no roughness variation across the shell.

lobby, lights-off: the tile floor stays almost as bright as in lights-on while the ceiling, coffers and kiosk screens all correctly go dark. An ambient/hemi term is flooding the floor independently of the house-light channel.

eng-neutral: the engineering state reads underexposed relative to the architecture neutral. lighting_notes.engineering asks to 'raise neutral fill slightly'; here the fill is lower, so the shell and zone volumes sit close to the background value.
corrections: Cut the auditorium ceiling and wall-fixture intensity so no auditorium surface exceeds the corridor's brightest surface. Target: auditorium ceiling luminance below the corridor ceiling (0.083 in the sidecar table) and below the auditorium wall value (0.213). Add ceiling to the zone_luminance_multisurface sampling so this tier is actually measured next time.

Re-drive the auditorium so the room is carved by its aisle LEDs, exit signs and screen bounce only. Remove or heavily attenuate the broad ceiling/wall wash pools; keep the step-nosing and aisle-strip spill, which already works.

Raise the in-room exit-sign emissive and/or enlarge the sign plates in sala-3 until they read as green EXIT signs in the architecture lights-on capture, matching how they already render in eng-sala-3.

Reframe the facade preset. Reduce the empty sky and empty plaza: lower the camera or raise the target so the building fills the middle band, and widen or pull back so the marquee is not clipped at the left and right frame edges. The building must not read as a thin band between two voids.

Add forecourt spill. Give the marquee, the canopy downlights and the poster bank a ground contribution so the plaza shows a visible pool with falloff in lights-on and loses it in lights-off. The plaza gray must differ between the two states.
Break up the smooth-plastic response the grazing pass exposes: vary roughness across the shell panels and the concrete plaza so the low angle produces varied specular rather than one flat gradient.
Gate the lobby floor on the house-light channel. The tile must darken with the ceiling in lights-off instead of holding its lit value from an ambient term.
Raise the engineering neutral fill per lighting_notes.engineering so the eng-neutral shell and zone volumes separate from the background.
Re-capture the full 24-image set after these changes; keep the neutral/grazing/reference-match look-dev trio, which is otherwise doing its job.

mechanical.note: 24/24 console sidecars clean; 165 unit tests pass; probe under budget (default-camera probe under-reads: the isometric preset was reframed onto the hero band)
